plan.scoring_rule: Twenty-class predict(); shared project accuracy/macro-F1/domain metrics.
plan.selection_rule: No automatic selection; score all eight fixed configurations once and retain all outcomes.
plan.mlp_stopping_rule: Sklearn stratified 10% internal split from the 2,760 training rows only; seed 42. The 200 development rows are never passed to fit().
plan.data_access: Only manifest.json, clients/client_0..4.npz, and validation.npz. No test or confirmation records are opened.
plan.interpretation: Centralized public-data task references on reused development validation, not independent confirmation, federated training, or LoRA. SVC support-vector dependence is not transferable to federation by claim.
